Scenario: Verify Root Entity exists
Description: ROOT retrieves system Root Entity to confirm bootstrap status.

Scenario: Create Level 1 Operator A
Description: ROOT creates level 1 Operator A which atomically creates Entity A.

Scenario: Create Level 1 Operator B
Description: ROOT creates level 1 Operator B which atomically creates Entity B.

Scenario: Create Policy FULL for Operator A
Description: ROOT creates Policy with FULL permissions on Entity A.

Scenario: Create Policy FULL for Operator B
Description: ROOT creates Policy with FULL permissions on Entity B.

Scenario: Create Policy READ for Operator A
Description: ROOT creates narrow Policy READ for Venue shadowing test.

Scenario: Create User Admin A
Description: ROOT creates administrative user `admina@rbac.local`.

Scenario: Create User Admin B
Description: ROOT creates administrative user `adminb@rbac.local`.

Scenario: Assign Role Admin A on Entity A
Description: ROOT scopes Admin A to Entity A with Policy FULL.

Scenario: Assign Role Admin B on Entity B
Description: ROOT scopes Admin B to Entity B with Policy FULL.

Scenario: Login Admin A
Description: Authenticates Admin A and acquires `admin_a_token`.

Scenario: Login Admin B
Description: Authenticates Admin B and acquires `admin_b_token`.

Scenario: Admin A creates Sub-User A (admin role)
Description: Admin A creates sub-user `subusera@rbac.local` (createdBy = Admin A).

Scenario: Admin A creates CSR user
Description: Admin A creates CSR role user `csra@rbac.local`.

Scenario: Admin A creates NOC user
Description: Admin A creates NOC role user `noca@rbac.local`.

Scenario: Admin A GET owned Sub-User A
Description: Admin A reads profile of Sub-User A created by Admin A.

Scenario: Admin A PUT owned Sub-User A
Description: Admin A updates profile of owned Sub-User A.

Scenario: Admin A list owned users
Description: Admin A lists users (OWSEC filters list to users created by Admin A).

Scenario: Admin A attempts to create ROOT user
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when trying to create a `root` role user.

Scenario: Admin A attempts to create PARTNER user
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when trying to create a `partner` role user.

Scenario: Admin A GET User Admin B (unowned)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when trying to read Admin B (created by ROOT).

Scenario: Admin A PUT User Admin B (unowned)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when trying to update Admin B.

Scenario: Admin A DELETE User Admin B (unowned)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when trying to delete Admin B.

Scenario: Admin A assign role to Admin B (unowned user)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when assigning role to user not created by Admin A.

Scenario: Admin A GET Entity A (in-scope)
Description: Admin A reads assigned Operator Entity A.

Scenario: Admin A create Level 2 Normal Entity
Description: Admin A creates Normal Entity 2 under Entity A.

Scenario: Admin A create Top Venue 1
Description: Admin A creates top-level Venue 1 under Entity A (auto-assigns creator venue role).

Scenario: Admin A create Child Venue 2
Description: Admin A creates nested child Venue 2 under Venue 1.

Scenario: Admin A GET Venue 1
Description: Admin A reads Venue 1 (in-scope).

Scenario: Admin A GET Child Venue 2
Description: Admin A reads Child Venue 2 (in-scope).

Scenario: Admin A GET Root Entity
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when reading system Root Entity.

Scenario: Admin A GET Entity B (sibling)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when reading sibling Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A PUT Entity B (sibling)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when updating sibling Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A DELETE Entity B (sibling)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when deleting sibling Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A POST Normal Entity under Entity B
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when creating Entity under out-of-scope Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A POST Venue under Entity B
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when creating Venue under out-of-scope Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A POST Operator
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when attempting to create an Operator (Operator creation requires ROOT).

Scenario: Admin A GET Operator B details
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when reading Operator B details.

Scenario: Admin A PUT Operator A object
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when updating Operator object directly.

Scenario: Admin A DELETE Operator A object
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when deleting Operator object directly.

Scenario: Admin A assign role to Sub-User A on Venue 1
Description: Admin A delegates role to Sub-User A on Venue 1 scope (valid in-scope delegation).

Scenario: Admin A GET roles list
Description: Admin A lists roles belonging to users created by Admin A.

Scenario: Admin A delegate role on out-of-scope Entity B
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when delegating role on out-of-scope Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A delegate role on Venue B
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when delegating role on Venue owned by Entity B.

Scenario: Admin A (venue role) delegate to parent Entity
Description: Validates upward scope delegation constraints.

Scenario: Admin A (READ policy) attempts to assign FULL policy to sub-user
Description: Admin A with narrow READ policy on Venue 1 is REJECTED when attempting to assign higher FULL policy to sub-user.

Scenario: Admin A submits multiple users in users array
Description: Admin A is REJECTED when submitting multiple users in users array.

Scenario: ROOT assigns narrow Venue Role (Policy READ) to Admin A on Venue 1
Description: ROOT assigns narrow Venue Role (Policy READ) to Admin A on Venue 1.

Scenario: Admin A PUT Venue 1 (Shadowed by Venue Role)
Description: Admin A is REJECTED from updating Venue 1 because narrow Venue Role (Policy READ) shadows Entity FULL role.

Scenario: Admin A GET Venue 1 (Shadowed by Venue Role)
Description: Admin A can READ Venue 1 because narrow Venue Role Policy READ permits READ access.

Scenario: Reject Level 3 Entity nesting under Level 2
Description: Rejects Normal Entity creation exceeding 3 levels of depth.

Scenario: Parent is immutable on Normal Entity
Description: Parent is immutable; PUT specifying parent is ignored by backend returning 200.

Scenario: Reject Entity delete with child Venue
Description: Rejects deleting Entity A while child Venue 1 exists.

Scenario: Reject Venue delete when child Venue exists
Description: Rejects deleting Venue 1 while nested Child Venue 2 exists.

Scenario: Delete Child Venue 2 by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes Child Venue 2.

Scenario: Delete Venue 1 by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes Venue 1.

Scenario: Delete Level 2 Entity 2 by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes Level 2 Normal Entity.

Scenario: Delete Role Sub-User A by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes Role Sub-User A.

Scenario: Delete Sub-User A by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes Sub-User A.

Scenario: Delete CSR User A by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes CSR User A.

Scenario: Delete NOC User A by Admin A
Description: Admin A deletes NOC User A.

Scenario: Delete Role Venue Shadow by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Role Venue Shadow.

Scenario: Delete User Admin A by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes User Admin A.

Scenario: Delete User Admin B by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes User Admin B.

Scenario: Delete Role Admin A by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Role Admin A.

Scenario: Delete Role Admin B by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Role Admin B.

Scenario: Delete Policy FULL A by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Policy FULL A.

Scenario: Delete Policy FULL B by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Policy FULL B.

Scenario: Delete Policy READ A by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Policy READ A.

Scenario: Delete Operator B by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Operator B.

Scenario: Delete Operator A by ROOT
Description: ROOT deletes Operator A.
